## 3. One circular wave at the front: local field and local inflow, over the whole circle of phases

B / B0 = (b cos phi, 1, s b sin phi) with b = sqrt(2) x 0.6 = 0.849 and phi = k y - omega t; |B| / B0 = 1.311 for every phase phi. The ion bulk velocity of the wave is dv = -0.797 v_A (cos phi, 0, s sin phi) at L_y = 50 d_i (helicity R, s = 1): the wave travels along +B0. theta_Bn: angle between B and the shock normal +x. psi: angle of the projection of B on the front plane (y, z) from y. Normal inflow: speed of the ions towards a front that moves at the shock speed of the uniform state, U1 - dv_x with U1 = 4.50 v_A; the last column divides it by the Alfvén speed on |B|.

## 4. How the wave meets the front: lengths and times

One circular wave, rms dB_x/B0 = 0.6, helicity R. xi_pp = sqrt(2) db L_y / pi: peak-to-peak excursion of a field line along x. Connected: xi_pp / U1, the time between the first touch of a field line's arc and the passage of its last point through a plane front. Period: 2 pi / omega, the time in which the phase at a fixed point y of the front goes once around the circle. Transit: (L_y / 2) / v_te with v_te = sqrt(T_e / m_e), the thermal time between the two intersections.

| L_y | k d_i | omega / Omega_ci | v_ph / v_A | ion dv / v_A | electron dv / v_A | xi_pp | Xi | connected | period | transit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 50 | 0.1257 | 0.1330 | 1.058 | -0.797 | -0.904 | 13.5 | 4.4 | 3.0 | 47 | 3.5 |
| 100 | 0.0628 | 0.0645 | 1.026 | -0.822 | -0.876 | 27.0 | 8.8 | 6.0 | 97 | 7.0 |
| 200 | 0.0314 | 0.0317 | 1.010 | -0.835 | -0.862 | 54.0 | 17.7 | 12.0 | 198 | 14.1 |
| 400 | 0.0157 | 0.0158 | 1.003 | -0.842 | -0.855 | 108.0 | 35.3 | 24.0 | 399 | 28.1 |
